options.name: api_key
options.description: A string that contains the obfuscated API key.

options.name: aup_custom_frequency
options.description: The custom frequency (in days) for showing the AUP to the end users. Valid range is 1 to 180.

options.name: aup_day_offset
options.description: Specifies which day of the week or month the AUP is shown for users when aupFrequency is set. Valid range is 1 to 31.

options.name: aup_frequency
options.description: The frequency at which the Acceptable Use Policy (AUP) is shown to the end users

options.name: aup_message
options.description: The acceptable use statement that is shown in the AUP

options.name: caution_again_after
options.description: The time interval at which the caution notification is shown when users continue browsing a restricted site. The recommended setting for complex websites, such as Social Networking sites, is at least 5 minutes.

options.name: caution_custom_text
options.description: The custom message that appears in the caution notification

options.name: caution_per_domain
options.description: Specifies whether to display the caution notification at a specific time interval for URLs in the Miscellaneous or Unknown category. This option is applicable when a user browses a URL or a sub-domain of a URL in the Miscellaneous or Unknown category.

options.name: client_id
options.description: The client ID for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: client_secret
options.description: The client secret for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: cloud
options.description: The Zscaler cloud name provisioned for your organization.

options.name: custom_text
options.description: The custom text shown in the EUN

options.name: display_comp_logo
options.description: Indicates whether your organization's logo appears in the EUN or not

options.name: display_comp_name
options.description: Indicates whether the organization's name appears in the EUN or not

options.name: display_reason
options.description: Indicates whether or not the reason for cautioning or blocking access to a site file, or application is shown when the respective notification is triggered

options.name: idp_proxy_notification_text
options.description: The message that appears in the IdP Proxy notification

options.name: notification_type
options.description: The type of EUN as default or custom

options.name: org_policy_link
options.description: The URL of the organization's policy page. This field is required for the default notification type.

options.name: password
options.description: A string that contains the password for the API admin.

options.name: private_key
options.description: The private key for JWT-based OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict containing authentication credentials.

options.name: quarantine_custom_notification_text
options.description: The message that appears in the quarantine notification

options.name: redirect_url
options.description: The redirect URL for the external site hosting the EUN specified when the custom notification type is selected

options.name: sandbox_cloud
options.description: The Sandbox cloud environment for API access.

options.name: sandbox_token
options.description: A string that contains the Sandbox API Key.

options.name: security_review_custom_location
options.description: A custom URL location where users' review requests for possible misclassified URLs are sent

options.name: security_review_enabled
options.description: Indicates whether the Security Violation notification is enabled or disabled

options.name: security_review_submit_to_security_cloud
options.displayName: Security Review Submit To Security Cloud
options.description: Indicates whether users' review requests for blocked URLs are submitted To the Zscaler service i.e. Security Cloud or a custom location.

options.name: security_review_text
options.description: The message that appears in the Security Violation notification

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies the desired state of the resource.

options.name: support_email
options.description: The email address for writing to IT Support

options.name: support_phone
options.description: The phone number for contacting IT Support

options.name: url_cat_review_custom_location
options.description: A custom URL location where users' review requests for blocked URLs are sent

options.name: url_cat_review_enabled
options.description: Indicates whether the URL Categorization notification is enabled or disabled

options.name: url_cat_review_submit_to_security_cloud
options.displayName: Url Cat Review Submit To Security Cloud
options.description: Indicates whether users' review requests for possibly misclassified URLs are submitted to the Zscaler service (i.e., Security Cloud) or a custom location. A true value indicates that the request is sent to the Security cloud, whereas a false value indicates that the request is sent to the specified custom location.

options.name: url_cat_review_text
options.description: The message that appears in the URL Categorization notification

options.name: use_legacy_client
options.description: Whether to use the legacy Zscaler API client.

options.name: username
options.description: A string that contains the email ID of the API admin.

options.name: vanity_domain
options.description: The vanity domain provisioned by Zscaler for OAuth2 flows.

options.name: web_dlp_review_custom_location
options.description: A custom URL location where users' review requests for the web DLP policy violation are sent

options.name: web_dlp_review_enabled
options.description: Indicates whether the Web DLP Violation notification is enabled or disabled

options.name: web_dlp_review_submit_to_security_cloud
options.displayName: Web Dlp Review Submit To Security Cloud
options.description: Indicates whether users' review requests for web DLP policy violation are submitted to the Zscaler service (i.e., Security Cloud) or a custom location. A true value indicates that the request is sent to the Security cloud, whereas a false value indicates that the request is sent to the specified custom location.

options.name: web_dlp_review_text
options.description: The message that appears in the Web DLP Violation notification
